findings: Equal-length rc.sysinit data replacement: drops the last two mount echo lines and appends a background Lua start after every mount; only the differing tail is stored.
The ROMFS inode checksum covers the unchanged 32-byte header/name and the filesystem checksum covers its unchanged first 512 bytes.

Physical boot acceptance FAILED: on a real Band 11, pinning corrupted flash and left the band in a boot loop (reported by the user, 2026-11-03). Pinned start is disabled for the whole Band 11 family (same /dev/bes_flash path on all three firmwares).
The erase block holds only the ROMFS tail (with rcS) and zero padding after it.
